queries.sql:
SELECT facility_id, name, city, icu_beds_avail, trust_calibrated
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final
WHERE icu_beds_avail > 0
ORDER BY trust_calibrated DESC
LIMIT 10
queries.explanation: Top facilities with ICU availability ranked by calibrated trust.

queries.sql:
SELECT facility_id, name, city, trust_calibrated, trust_source
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final
WHERE trust_calibrated >= 0.80
ORDER BY trust_calibrated DESC
queries.explanation: Facilities with calibrated trust >= 0.80, ordered by trust.

queries.sql:
SELECT facility_id, name, city, trust_calibrated
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final
WHERE array_contains(specialties, 'cardiology')
ORDER BY trust_calibrated DESC
LIMIT 5
queries.explanation: Cardiology-capable facilities ranked by calibrated trust.
